mapper.insert: insert into basket_team_season_profile (team_id, season_id, registration_id, event_team_no, team_name_snapshot, short_name_snapshot, description_snapshot, game_terminal, registration_source, participation_status, roster_lock_status, roster_locked_time, approved_time, display_name, logo_file_id, captain_player_id, registration_status, season_status, remark, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{teamId}, #{seasonId}, #{registrationId}, #{eventTeamNo}, #{teamNameSnapshot}, #{shortNameSnapshot}, #{descriptionSnapshot}, #{gameTerminal}, #{registrationSource}, #{participationStatus}, #{rosterLockStatus}, #{rosterLockedTime}, #{approvedTime}, #{displayName}, #{logoFileId}, #{captainPlayerId}, #{registrationStatus}, #{seasonStatus}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.select: select * from basket_team_season_profile where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select * from basket_team_season_profile where registration_id = #{registrationId} and is_delete = 0 limit 1
select * from basket_team_season_profile where team_id = #{teamId} and season_id = #{seasonId} and is_delete = 0 limit 1
select max(cast(substring(event_team_no, 9) as unsigned)) from basket_team_season_profile where season_id = #{seasonId} and event_team_no like 'CNPA-ET-%' and is_delete = 0
select count(1) from basket_team_season_profile where season_id = #{seasonId} and event_team_no = #{eventTeamNo} and is_delete = 0

select p.id, p.season_id as seasonId, p.team_id as teamId, p.registration_id as registrationId, p.event_team_no as eventTeamNo, p.team_name_snapshot as teamNameSnapshot, p.game_terminal as gameTerminal, p.participation_status as participationStatus, p.roster_lock_status as rosterLockStatus, p.approved_time as approvedTime, p.captain_player_id as captainPlayerId, ifnull(nullif(cap.game_nickname, ''), ma.username) as captainNameSnapshot, s.season_name as seasonName, t.team_no as teamNo, tm.tournament_name as tournamentName from basket_team_season_profile p inner join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = p.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_team t on t.id = p.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_tournament tm on tm.id = s.tournament_id and tm.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile cap on cap.id = p.captain_player_id and cap.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_account ma on ma.id = cap.member_id and ma.is_delete = 0 where p.is_delete = 0 and p.season_id = #{seasonId} and p.event_team_no like concat('%', #{eventTeamNo}, '%') and p.team_name_snapshot like concat('%', #{teamName}, '%') and p.participation_status = #{participationStatus} and p.roster_lock_status = #{rosterLockStatus} order by p.approved_time desc, p.id desc

select p.id, p.season_id as seasonId, p.team_id as teamId, p.registration_id as registrationId, p.event_team_no as eventTeamNo, p.team_name_snapshot as teamNameSnapshot, p.short_name_snapshot as shortNameSnapshot, t.region_name as teamRegionSnapshot, p.description_snapshot as descriptionSnapshot, p.game_terminal as gameTerminal, p.registration_source as registrationSource, p.participation_status as participationStatus, p.roster_lock_status as rosterLockStatus, p.roster_locked_time as rosterLockedTime, p.approved_time as approvedTime, p.captain_player_id as captainPlayerId, ifnull(nullif(cap.game_nickname, ''), ma.username) as captainNameSnapshot, p.display_name as displayName, p.logo_file_id as logoFileId, p.remark, s.season_name as seasonName, t.team_no as teamNo, tm.tournament_name as tournamentName from basket_team_season_profile p inner join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = p.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_team t on t.id = p.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_tournament tm on tm.id = s.tournament_id and tm.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile cap on cap.id = p.captain_player_id and cap.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_account ma on ma.id = cap.member_id and ma.is_delete = 0 where p.id = #{id} and p.is_delete = 0
mapper.update: update basket_team_season_profile set roster_lock_status = #{rosterLockStatus}, roster_locked_time = #{rosterLockedTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
update basket_team_season_profile set participation_status = #{participationStatus}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
update basket_team_season_profile set captain_player_id = #{captainPlayerId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select * from basket_team_season_profile where season_id = #{seasonId} and is_delete = 0 and participation_status = 1 and approved_time is not null order by id
select count(1) from basket_team_season_profile where season_id = #{seasonId} and is_delete = 0 and participation_status = 1 and approved_time is not null

select p.registration_id from basket_team_season_profile p where p.is_delete = 0 and p.registration_id is not null and p.approved_time is not null and (p.roster_lock_status is null or p.roster_lock_status != 1) order by p.approved_time asc, p.id asc
